# `flagEscalation`

**Kind:** function tool — a background task
**Source model:** `grace_contracts.tools.escalation_tools.FlagEscalationInput`
**Generated JSON:** `platform/vapi/tools/flagEscalation.json`

## What it does, and when Grace calls it

Call this IMMEDIATELY BEFORE transferToHuman, every single time. It creates the staff task and gives the person picking up the context they need — without it they answer blind. Summarise in one sentence, and never put medical or health detail in the summary; say "a health matter" instead.

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type / allowed values | Required | Default | What it means |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | `asked_for_person` · `frustrated` · `complaint` · `refund` · `gift_certificate` · `medical` · `recording_objection` · `no_tool` · `repeated_failure` | **yes** | — | Why you are handing off. Pick the closest match. |
| `summary` | `string`, length 1–200 | **yes** | — | One sentence of context for the person picking up, e.g. "Caller wants to dispute a late-cancel fee." NEVER include medical, health, or diagnostic detail — say "a health matter" instead. |
| `urgency` | `normal` · `high` | no | `"normal"` | Use 'high' only if the caller is upset or the matter is time-critical. |

Any parameter not listed above is **rejected**, not ignored — the model inventing a field must be a loud error, never silent.

## Settings

| Setting | Value | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Runs in background | **yes** | Vapi resolves it immediately and never returns the result to the model |

| p95 target | — | A target for alerting, **not** a deadline — the deadline is `GRACE_TOOL_DEADLINE_MS` |
| Request timeout | 10 s | Above our own deadline, so our graceful sentence fires first |

| Live Vapi ID | `c657f101-a2da-4e21-afc3-e845d655edb2` | Vapi dashboard → **Tools** |

Deliberately silent. The prompt requires `transferToHuman` immediately after this tool, and that speaks — two acknowledgements in a row would be worse than none.
